text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo, Trainer! Did you get plenty 
of rest over there, too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I focused completely on resting without 
picking up any shifts, so I was able to 
really, truly let my hair down!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, doing absolutely nothing kind of 
makes me restless in its own way. Ahaha, 
maybe I just didn't know what to do with 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll train with everything I've got 
today to make up for all that fidgeting~♪

Ines Fujin is in high spirits. It seems 
she got plenty of rest!
